_README: Sales-call / buyer-interview evidence channel (audit Section 7, step 3). Each record in 'observations' is a beliefs.RateObservation-shaped close-rate datum, fed through beliefs.update_beta to move the sponsor close-rate / WTP belief. THIS is the ONLY channel that can move a belief to OBSERVED: grounding.py marks research_close_prob and research_wtp_actual PRIMARY (they exist nowhere online; only a real buyer yes/no resolves them). Empty until AJ's first call lands here.

_schema.successes: float -- buyers who signed / committed in this batch
_schema.failures: float -- buyers who declined in this batch
_schema.kind: one of SIGNED_COMMERCIAL | DIRECT_OBSERVATION | EMPIRICAL_RATE | BUYER_STATED | EXTERNAL_COMPARABLE | EXPERT_PRIOR | MODEL_ESTIMATE (see beliefs.EVIDENCE_WEIGHT)

_rule: Only SIGNED_COMMERCIAL / DIRECT_OBSERVATION can move a belief to OBSERVED, and only once they are at least half of the posterior pseudo-count mass (beliefs.update_beta). A single signed obs among comparable-grade mass stays ASSUMED.
